comparison.objective: Install a rigid bracket, versus fit an O-ring into a hydraulic plug groove.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid multi-feature alignment/latching versus controlled elastic stretching, sliding over threads, untwisted seating, and careful release.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket self-support/no deformation versus ring fully seated square and untwisted without exceeding the irreversible 50% stretch limit.
comparison.reason: The PR tests validated deformable manipulation and damage limits absent from the candidate.
